court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Kishore Dharmabalan Mundakel vs Geeta Maruti Dhotre Alias Geeta Kishore

parties.respondent_defendant: Geeta Maruti Dhotre @ Geeta Kishore Mundakel — wife

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The parties are in a marital dispute. The respondent-wife filed an application for maintenance and custody of the child. The trial court allowed the application, and this is an appeal against that order.

legal_principles.principle: The aggrieved person shall be bound to inform the Magistrate of the grant of such relief.
legal_principles.held: Sub-clause (3) lays down that the aggrieved person shall be bound to inform the Magistrate of the reliefs obtained by her in any proceeding other than proceedings under the proposed legislation.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 26

legal_principles.principle: When multiple proceedings are pending, it is desirable to hear them together to avoid conflicts of interest.
legal_principles.held: He submits that if both the matters are heard together then, there is no question of any conflicts of the interest of both the parties.
cited_cases: Sandip Mrinmoy Chakraboarty Vs. Reshita Sandip Chakrabarty & Ors., (2019) 1 Bombay Case Report (Criminal) 297

outcome.final_order: The order passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Mumbai in Criminal Appeal No.611 of 2016 is set aside along with the order dated 06.05.2016 passed by 27th Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Mulund.
